proposals.defect: When a request succeeds without fallback, the sticky start is reset to the primary route, so the next request calls the previously failing primary route again instead of starting from the last successful route.

The sticky start only ever moves forward (max of old and new index), so if a later fallback succeeds on a lower-index route, the next request still starts from the higher index instead of the most recent success.
